summary: Documentation only: the v0.36.0 changelog row names agent 0.35.2 instead of 0.35.1 and states that it is the same code as 0.35.1, built with golang.org/x/sys 0.50.0 (#153), because the v0.35.1 provenance rebuild diverged after #153 updated the dependency once 0.35.1 had been built. No code, configuration, workflow, dependency or agent source changes; building, signing and releasing the agent stay with the maintainer's release process (release_anlegen.py refuses a release when agent/ changed since its files were built).

findings.evidence: The row announces a rebuilt agent binary for the next release.
findings.resolution: Pre-existing update-trust controls (signing, provenance rebuild, release tool check) apply unchanged; this change only documents the version.

limitations: The agent binary 0.35.2 itself is not built or verified by this change.
